summary: Registered cohort reviewed using ESM sequence preferences; phenotype remains unvalidated.
model_narrative: A32V was reviewed for sequence plausibility at position 32 in ESTA_BACSU_Nutschel_2020 using approved model esm150. It showed only a mid-rank masked sequence preference, with protected positions 108, 164, and 187 unchanged. ESM scores are sequence preferences, not T50, activity, solubility, Tm or experimental validation, so function and geometry remain unverified.

score_artifacts.limitations: ESM sequence preference; T50, activity and retained function are unknown.
